slides.title: The Koh Tao dive guide, now in Ocean Flow
slides.body: Dive sites, marine life and everything you need for the briefing. Now you can search for the dive site directly! Access it from the Home tile.

slides.title: Your Home, at a glance
slides.body: This month's numbers, your calendar and what you have pending to collect. All on the screen you open the app to.

slides.title: My work: log every entry
slides.body: Classes, commissions and adjustments with colleagues, all from the same button. No hunting for the right form each time.

slides.title: Summary, with your PDF report
slides.body: Check what you've earned by period and download your full report as a PDF whenever you need it.

slides.title: Generate your Training Records
slides.body: Each student's official SSI progress document, with your signature and theirs, ready to download.

slides.title: Questions? Help is right there
slides.body: Step-by-step guides for every screen. Find it by tapping the icon at the top right, whenever you need it.

slides.title: Start here
slides.body: Create your first school and set up its rates. That's all you need to log your first entry in Ocean Flow.
